message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes. Facts: multiple thefts of electric cables (盗窃) three times, total value 26653.69. Also illegal disposal of seized property: he stole a car that was seized by court and drove it away (非法处置扣押的财产). That is crime of illegal handling of seized property (非法处置扣押的财产) maybe under law: “非法处置扣押的财产” is a crime. Also earlier he had prior conviction for seeking trouble (寻衅滋事) but that's prior, not part of current. So charges: theft (multiple counts) maybe "盗窃" and "非法处置扣押的财产". Also possibly "非法买卖废旧金属" but that's part of theft. The illegal disposal is separate. So answer: 盗窃;非法处置扣押的财产. Use semicolon.
